messages:
Iris: weekend dilemma  do I spend Saturday morning weeding the balcony jungle or join a 10k on the ridge? low energy but craving nature. :seedling: :running_shoe:
Jon: run if you canfresh air and bragging rights.
Hannah: balcony gardening for me. i find it zen and also guilty pleasure to re-pot succulents.
Ethan: 10k sounds fun. i'll be there and bring portable electrolytes.
Iris: @Hannah succulents, yes. @Jon @Ethan is the 10k a low-key community run or hardcore?
Jon: community run, mostly trails and friendly dogs. parking is a pain tho.
Hannah: balcony can be laterif you're indecisive, split morning: 7:30 water/plants, 9:30 meet the runners for coffee?
Iris: that could work. early plant triage and then cheer squad. love the hybrid plan.
Ethan: i can loop back after the run to help with heavier pots if needed.
GardenBot: Reminder: "Balcony Plant TLC" checklist sent to Iris. Soil, gloves, small trowel.
Iris: ok final plan: 7:30 plants, 10:00 run meet for coffee at the usual spot. bringing spare gloves in case anyone wants to join.
Jon: i'll snag post-run pastries. :croissant:
Hannah: i'll bring a tiny pruning shear and some advice on repotting.
Ethan: see you all saturday!
